reviews.title: Great But Slow
reviews.text: This game is great, and does have a lot of in depth mechanics, that apply to running a business, and loosing or gaining profit. Although I do have to say, it’s rather slow. I’ve reset multiple times on the fourth expansion, and can’t gain money any faster than what I am now. It’s very difficult to get inspiration points once you get to a certain level, I love the game, but I don’t like how slow it is.

reviews.title: Great Idle Game
reviews.text: I have really enjoyed this idle game. I play a lot of them, and few have kept me invested like this one. It’s a bit of a slower burn one, but in a great way that makes it feel more natural and keeps me coming back, rather than having to be very active in large chunks to get back to idling. I love beer too, so I like the beer theme a lot. My only complaint is just the visual assets, as some buildings overlap with each other and it’s a bit off putting. Very small thing. Overall though, I’m still playing through, and plan on playing through as much as I can because it has continued to impress me.

reviews.title: NOT pay to play
reviews.text: Incredible game with very limited ads. no pop up ads that interrupt you in the middle of doing something. and most of all there isn’t much more you can do than play the game to be successful. there’s small boost ads, but they are limited and can only be activated by you. the story is fun, the prestige system works great, and the spider web of abilities adds a fun personal experience. If i had to add anything to this game, it would be making the city more interactive or maybe being able to make a personal character. that being said the game is great how it is!! hoping for updates and more games from you guys !

reviews.title: This games peak
reviews.text:
It has a pretty minimalist but cute art style it’s a pretty straight and too the point idle game but with some fun mechanics like different brew tanks that boost you in one way while hurting you in another and you can manage prices of the beers to effect the demand/sell rate so if you like min maxing and crunching numbers in your head to optimize your run and see how fast you can get all the beers unlocked then there you go

I’m rambling but this game is pretty good despite it’s simple appearance 
One of the things I really like is that there aren’t ads only optional ones that give you decent rewards and like 3 micro transactions mostly just giving you a 2x boost to yeast removing ads but keeping rewards and cosmetic upgrades I love it when devs do that
